items.evidence: main.py --headless --board 3 with a found script (240 right;270 none;500 right;530 none): tick 609 board 3 score 20, tick 611 board 4 'Board 4 of 4', screen play, ball (-2.999,1.248,0) just after spawn, coins (-2,0.25,0),(2.2,1.2,0),(3.5,0.25,1.5), sounds ...coin,clear. --board 4 accepted, --board 5 rejected. Frame shows slab+ramp.

--board 4, '0 right': y on ramp rises to 0.96 with -1<x<1; y>0.6 with x>1 for 24 ticks (t93 x1.06 y0.98). Side approach (-z at x 0..0.6) stopped at z=1.25; rolling on the top face and rolling back: my own box geometry check shows ball centre never closer than R=0.25 to the ramp box.

--board 4 script '0 right;90 none;106 left;156 down;181 none': air coin taken at t105 with ball (1.80,0.96,0) in flight; at 600 screen won, score 30, coins []. Board 3 start + run34 script reaches won with score 60 at tick 1300.
--board 1..4 in en/es/fr: 'Board N of 4', 'Tablero N de 4', 'Plateau N sur 4'; also in paused texts and frames.

Language right from en: es, fr, en; left from en: fr. With fr: title [Roll,Démarrer,Réglages,Quitter], settings [Réglages,Volume : 8,Langue : Français,Balle : Normale,Retour], play [Plateau 1 sur 4,Score : 0,Vies : 3], paused [En pause,Reprendre,Retour au titre], won [Vous avez gagné,...,Appuyez sur Entrée pour revenir au titre], lost [Partie terminée,...]; language fr.

Settings texts: Settings, Volume, Language, Ball: Normal, Back (Ball 3rd, before Back). On Ball row menu_right->heavy, ->light (wrap), menu_left->light, default normal; shown as Ligera/Normal (es), Lourde/Normale (fr); ball_kind in state follows.

Board 2, settings ball_kind light/normal/heavy, same pushes: ball x at tick before strike identical (-0.571896 / -0.526104 / -0.507451 for three scripts). Sum of six crate displacements 120 ticks after strike: '0 right;60 none' light 2.17 < normal 3.58 < heavy 6.62; '0 right;40 none' 0.86 < 2.24 < 3.97 (with '0 right' heavy even knocks a crate off).

Settings dir run set fr+heavy; settings.json {volume 8, language fr, ball_kind heavy}; next run starts fr/heavy. A pre-change file {volume 5, language es} loads as 5/es/normal, and changing Ball then writes ball_kind.
All m01-m24 rechecked on the changed game and pass (see m items).

--board 4 --frame: 800x480 PNG; shows slab, ramp as an orange slab with a visible thickness at its high end, ball with shadow, 3 coins (the air one drawn raised); after the ground coin is taken only the 2 remaining coins are drawn.

CHANGES.md lists each change with files/functions (game.py BOARDS[4], ball_ramp, STR fr, SETTINGS_ITEMS, ball_crate; render.py; font.py; main.py), what was checked and how, and pre-existing faults found.

defects: French won screen frame: 'VOUS AVEZ GAGNÉ' is wider than 800 px, its first and last letters are cut off at the edges.
The ramp's underside is not shown as distinct from its top in the frame; tilt is mostly read from the thickness face at the high end.
